detections.evidence_quote: 18-month-long program, dialectical behavioral therapy. I had both books memorized.
detections.summary: Guest describes an 18-month, $25,000 dialectical behavior therapy (DBT) program whose material was so clinical she could not apply it in her own life, which shaped her own methods.
